Current aggregate: `aa56744ec`. Private native union target preparation is integrated (no code emission): 1,272 observed and 122 linked checks across six originals pass in the component. Its actual aggregate Make check remains pending because local disk is critical; the required hosted target is wired, and ten workflow controls pass. The shared native test harnesses now place object users before static archives; actual map preparation, five process/link controls, and an explicit GNU ld negative/corrected execution control pass. Exact Linux qualification remains required. STRING→STRING map consumers and paired publication remain integrated. Union fields now have copied declarations, bounded descriptive origins, private recipes, independently re-proved images, preparation and a private VM executor. Aggregate execution passes 344 linked checks on six retained originals and 633 instrumented checks in each dispatch mode, plus 68 workflow/checkpoint/schema controls. Component coverage includes initializer/HALT/assertion semantics, ordinary GC aliases, retain saturation, allocation recovery, old runtime compatibility and six unchanged budget rows. Public/native union selection and source publication remain closed. Exact current-head hosted qualification is queued (CI39707859417; retirement39707859526). The cd9146 Linux retirement lane passed; its compiler-contract lane exposed the archive-order build failure repaired here. Earlier Linux results remain prior-head evidence; two older Darwin lanes failed the same 24 linker capture cases and exact selected-tool diagnostic39695000967 is still queued. None exhaustive-match and historical alias precision remain conservative boundaries. Required native/public/publisher and authority work remains open; this does not close #976/#998/#999/#1001.

I integrate the 5.1 compiler corrections, retained compiler facts, bounded ownership reconstruction and the qualification paths needed to assess the combined release candidate. This PR remains a review candidate; it does not publish 5.1 or close #976, #998, #999 or #1001.

Imported global initializers retain their declaring module. Record/BOOL joins, field setters and nested-array writes preserve exact representations and once-only evaluation. Ordinary-record authority is published only after complete original-module proof, including concrete generic instances, primitive array fields and bounded nested arrays. Canonical native records preserve shared identity, and qualified acyclic tail calls retain the correct invocation root. Forged descriptors, transport, forced collection, retain headroom and allocation-failure recovery remain checked.

Advisory purity/effects, generic specialization provenance, match coverage, affine completion/use sites and checked call-borrow/read/write projections retain their producer identity. Checked global effects use bound symbols inside a synchronous check-and-emit bridge. Borrow/read/write events use invocation-local ledgers and completed checker identities; raw/generic/synthetic contexts remain absent where no checked fact exists. Advisory bytes never authorize execution. Imported same-spelled resource functions receive unique wire names without changing numeric identities or relaxing assembler duplicate rejection.

Structured reconstruction now covers the finite mapped ownership anchors: consuming locals/calls/results/VOID, bounded nested parents, exact shared/exclusive references and projections, helper-local owners, reassignment, innermost break/continue/range, eager one/two-call pretests and loop-first witnesses. STRING forwarding/printing preserves observable byte order. FLOAT locals retain binary64 literal facts, finite Nano literals and typed arithmetic/control; correctly rounded nonzero subnormals are accepted by the assembler while zero-underflow/overflow still refuse. Empty owners retain nominal identity and consumption, including the exact independent-empty/nonempty-exclusive composition. Temporary arguments, transitive wrappers and nested results qualify without additional admission changes. Existing local/work/depth/signature bounds remain enforced; unsupported nonfinite Nano literals and broader profiles still refuse atomically. No VM/goto dispatcher or weaker verifier replaces the proofs.

Instrumented jobs now share a single immutable image archive built from a digest-pinned base and signed fixed package snapshot. Checkpoint validation still binds exact source, flags, tool/runtime identities, artifacts and directory timestamps; outer runner image labels are diagnostic. Split sanitizer and coverage jobs preserve their test budgets and fail closed on mismatched continuation inputs. Host compiler deadlines and process cleanup remain separate from guest execution limits.

Current evidence:

- Fresh raw generations, fixed-point equality, native compiler smoke checks and checked-fact neighbors are retained in [checked-field-write bootstrap](docs/evidence/checked-field-write-bootstrap-20261019/) and [FLOAT bootstrap aggregate](docs/evidence/owned-float-reconstruction-aggregate-20261019/). These identify their exact source/tool pins and are not represented as fresh generations of every later Python/facts change.
- The [finite reconstruction scope map](docs/NANOISA_RECONSTRUCTION_REQUIRED_SCOPE_MAP.md) links the component and aggregate receipts, original failures, exact local boundaries, old-output byte controls and independent original-shadow provenance. Latest aggregate results include double-call7/123.219s, loop-first8/117.399s, consuming FLOAT exits7/28.551s and borrowed-empty6/38.645s.
- [Complete wrapper qualification](docs/evidence/owned-wrapper-complete-20261020/) passes three methods in60.842s: all three original producers plus independently selected C-hosted shadow inputs, both output languages, all-three regenerated verification and O0/O2 ASan/UBSan native execution with exact stdout. The combined31-method gate passes371.344s at852f98d9b with unchanged provider/source pins; [combined receipt](docs/evidence/reconstruction-combined-852-20261020/) is committed at7f3fb215e.
- [Pinned-container evidence](docs/evidence/immutable-instrumented-container-20261020/) retains actual local ARM64 and hosted amd64 image/transport/instrumentation checks. In old component run39544892945, coverage generations/cross-job restore and sanitizer Stage1 passed. Continuation jobs later failed: ASan reached an obsolete schema-test dispatch spelling (fixed by integrated8bb872b97); coverage rejected a replacement-build checkpoint after a header dependency test rebuilt shared objects (isolated by integratedaf4d870f9). Current-head full continuation success remains pending; these are not passing release receipts.
- [Capture diagnostics](docs/evidence/source-capture-hosted-diagnostic-20261020/) retain the Linux capture correction and actual Apple15/16 debug-replay/backend failures. Linux capture and the three nested-array generated-C regressions pass their targeted gates. The corrected Xcode27 macOS diagnostic39559923169 passes all eight unchanged capture methods593.318s. Retirement now selects those exact compiler/assembler identities through executable wrappers, preserving arguments and parser checks, with the observed SDK path/version. All34 aggregate selector/workflow/checkpoint/container controls pass; full macOS retirement qualification remains open.

- [Nested primitive authority](docs/evidence/nested-primitive-authority-20261021/) qualifies exact depth-two INT/U8/FLOAT/BOOL/STRING leaf obligations while preserving historical budgets. New primitive consumers include100 native sanitizer products, allocation failures/recovery and exact FLOAT bits. Final aggregate rebuilt providers pass the required consumer target and26 paired source methods; [aggregate receipt](docs/evidence/nested-primitive-aggregate-20261021/). Depth-three and the remaining map/union/tuple/callable/recursive authority scope stay open.

Exact candidate0c31f5335 CI39565641936 and retirement39565641963 are queued from the PR update; prior exact-head runs remain retained. Final Linux/Darwin, sanitizer/coverage and complete release acceptance remain required. Historical checkpoints and failed terminals remain in the linked receipts and issue comments, rather than being treated as current failures or silently discarded.

Current exact CI [39580945241](https://github.com/jordanhubbard/nanolang/actions/runs/39580945241) and release qualification [39580945418](https://github.com/jordanhubbard/nanolang/actions/runs/39580945418) are queued; I retain all earlier runs.

All 68 workflow/capture/checkpoint/container/schema controls passed in 1.966s. Component strict checks, old public output equality and six legacy budget rows remain green. The actual aggregate scoped gate covers25 modules and50 sanitized native runs, including separately selected C/checked-Nano/raw-Nano shadows, forced collection and independent omission. Receipts: `docs/evidence/map-paired-publication-aggregate-20261021/` and `docs/evidence/map-paired-publication-20261022/`.

### Exact map deletion aggregate checkpoint

Receipts: `docs/evidence/map-delete-aggregate-20261021/README.md`, `docs/evidence/map-delete-consumer-20261022/README.md`, and `docs/evidence/map-delete-publication-20261022/README.md`.
